# Product 0xF001 - ESP32-S3: # confirm itself falls back to the updater
# NOTE the cost of this arrangement: there is only ONE updater image
# updater itself has no A/B slot to roll back to. A bad updater is a bad unit.
# No factory partition: the bootloader never rolls back to a factory image.
# cfg_factory and cfg_setting below are DATA partitions
#   cfg_factory - one 4 KB sector of provisioning data written in production
#                 (serial
#                 sectors: read and erase it raw through esp_partition_*.
#   cfg_setting - 16 KB = four sectors of runtime settings
#                 subtype nvs only if it is ever handed to nvs_flash: four
#                 sectors is three plus one spare
# The first partition starts at 0xF000
# is deliberately left empty behind the partition table.
# App partitions must start on a 64 KB boundary. The table sits at 0x8000 and
# is 0xC00 long
